extra.final_summary: Found and fixed data issues affecting the total body mass by species. Three rows had impossible negative flipper lengths (rows 9, 16, 19) and were excluded. Three rows had body mass values over 4 million grams (rows 22, 28, 49), which is 600 times the maximum expected; these were excluded. Two 'sex' entries had extra spaces (rows 10, 46) and were normalized to 'male'. After these fixes, the total body mass by species is: Adelie: 66,500 g, Chinstrap: 53,225 g, Gentoo: 77,600 g.
